species.real: Feeding Gibraltar's macaques is against the law and carries a hefty fine, because snacks from tourists make them bolder, fatter and much keener on your bag.
species.name: Macaquet

dex.text: A tailless, rust-brown ape with a worried brow and a very good idea where you keep your sandwiches. It sits on the wall of the Rock with the air of a landlord, and it is not paying anyone a penny.
dex.fact: The Barbary macaque of Gibraltar is the only wild monkey in Europe, and it has no tail, which is why the Rock's old name for it was the Barbary ape. A few hundred live in several troops. The old saying is that when the apes leave the Rock, the British will leave too, and Churchill is said to have ordered their numbers restored during the Second World War.
